in_sanskrit.name: गुरुगोविन्द
in_sanskrit.meaning: गुरु (teacher) + गोविन्द (Lord Krishna, the remover of sorrow)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The teacher who bestows joy or The joyful teacher

in_hindi.name: गुरुगोविंद
in_hindi.meaning: गुरु (गुरु, teacher) + गोविंद (गोविंद, कृष्ण, the remover of sorrow)
in_hindi.long_meaning: आचार्य जी (Honorable teacher) + कृष्ण (Lord Krishna), the one who removes sorrow and bestows joy

in_tamil.name: குருகோவிந்த

in_tamil.long_meaning: அடிகள் (teachers) + கோவிந்த (Krishna), the one who removes sorrow and bestows joy

in_marathi.name: Gurugovind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurugovind हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gurugovind is derived from Sanskrit words 'Guru' meaning teacher or spiritual master, and 'Govind' meaning 'one who brings pleasure'. The name signifies the blessings of a spiritual master, or the grace and pleasure one receives from a guru's teachings.
